summary: Dynex Capital filed an 8-K after pricing an underwritten public offering of 4,800,000 shares of 9.375% Series D Fixed-Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at a $25.00 liquidation preference, with a 30-day option for up to 720,000 additional shares. An underwriting agreement dated September 22, 2026 was signed with Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, RBC, UBS, Wells Fargo, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and KBW as representatives. Articles of Amendment effective September 29, 2026 designated 5,520,000 authorized preferred shares; quarterly cumulative dividends are payable January, April, July and October 15. Watch preferred overhang and dividend coverage.
